verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions a design-tool integration (such as a plugin or extension inside a design app) that would let a designer update Wrike status without leaving that tool. The two-way syncs name Jira and GitHub, not design tools. The API and MCP connections are developer building blocks or AI-assistant links, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a designer, I can keep project status updated from my design tool without switching apps
